description: Tether layout capabilities. Layouts contain data only; unknown fields are refused.

waiting.description: Agents and approvals that need attention; may also sit above or below a main panel.

chat.description: The conversation workspace. Required exactly once as a main panel.

agents.description: The existing agent tab strip above chat; never a grid panel.

status.description: Agents grouped by state in a separate column.

activity.description: The wide-screen navigation rail; only the main panel of the first column.

grid.description: One main panel per column, optional edge panels. Non-chat widths are pixels; chatWidth 0 fills available space. sessionsClosed hides sessions initially.

theme.description: Six-digit hex colours only. Text must meet minContrast on bg and surface.

options.avatars: Each session row shows a round avatar with initials and its colour, two-line name and last message, like a messenger app

options.bubbles: Agent replies sit in rounded bubbles on the left, user messages on the right

options.underline: Tabs with an underline for the selected tab
options.square: Square tabs with a selected edge

options.theme: The phone keeps its own layout and takes the colours and style
options.keep: The phone ignores this layout completely

features.description: Floating bubble with agent counts and unread work; stays above the workspace when enabled.
Pinned sessions stay available at the screen edge.
Chat notices, approvals and status cards stay above the composer.
Message input, attachments, model controls and voice controls remain available.
Settings, actions, search and other sheets and dialogs keep their own interactions.
The navigation rail remains available on wide screens.
Short action and error messages stay visible above the workspace.
The reload chip still appears when a new UI build is available.

limits.description: Custom layout file and text limits. Built-in ids cannot be saved or deleted.
